lessons.title: 1. Stack with a List
lessons.description: Implement `Stack` with push, pop, and peek using a Python list (end is top).

tests.name: test_stack
tests.unittest_code:
def test_stack(self):
    s = Stack()
    s.push(1); s.push(2)
    self.assertEqual(s.peek(), 2)
    self.assertEqual(s.pop(), 2)
    self.assertEqual(len(s), 1)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 5.1.1. Using Lists as Stacks — append()/pop() (Tutorial)

lessons.title: 2. Queue with collections.deque

tests.name: test_queue
tests.unittest_code:
def test_queue(self):
    q = Queue()
    q.enqueue('a'); q.enqueue('b')
    self.assertEqual(q.dequeue(), 'a')
    self.assertEqual(len(q), 1)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — collections.deque — append()/popleft() at O(1)
